headline: Brent Crude Tops $116 per Barrel as Middle East Conflict Rages
summary: Brent crude climbed above $116 a barrel, marking its highest price level since late April as escalating Middle East hostilities stoked energy supply fears.
why: Brent crude is the international benchmark for oil pricing, heavily influencing global inflation, transport expenses, and central bank policy.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical conflict in the Middle East has intensified supply disruption risks across major oil exporting corridors.

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: Soaring crude prices directly increase jet fuel expenses, squeezing carrier margins.

why_moved: Oil prices jumped past $116 per barrel due to supply disruption concerns stemming from escalating armed conflict in the Middle East.
